steps.data: <?php .wpcf7 input[type="text"], .wpcf7 input[type="email"], .wpcf7 textarea { background: #fff; colomr: #2c3338; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Oxygen-Sans, Ubuntu, Cantarell, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 2; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #8c8f94; border-radius: 4px; } .wpcf7 input, .wpcf7 textarea, .wpcf7 form .wpcf7-response-output { margin: 0 !important; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 400px; }  .wpcf7 input[type="text"]:focus, .wpcf7 input[type="email"]:focus, .wpcf7 textarea:focus { border-color: #2271b1; outline: 2px solid transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #2271b1; }  .wpcf7 input[type="submit"], .wpcf7 input[type="button"] { background-color: #2271b1; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #2271b1; border-radius: 3px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; text-align: center; text-transform: none; cursor: pointer; }  .wpcf7 input[type="submit"]:hover, .wpcf7 input[type="button"]:hover { background-color: #135e96; border-color: #135e96; }  .wpcf7 input[type="submit"]:focus, .wpcf7 input[type="button"]:focus { background-color: #135e96; border-color: #0a4b78; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #fff, 0 0 0 3px #2271b1; outline: 2px solid transparent; }
